title: Manipur CM Visits Family of Late Rakesh Singh, Pays Tribute at Sangaiyumpham
summary: Khemchand also prayed for peace for the departed soul and strength for the grieving family as they cope with the loss.
body:
Thoubal, October 28: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Wednesday visited the family of late Laishram Rakesh Singh at Khangabok Part-II, Mayai Leikai, in Thoubal district to offer his condolences following the youth’s death in an incident on October 18.

The Chief Minister was accompanied by Heirok Assembly constituency MLA and Government of Manipur spokesperson Thokchom Radheshyam, Kshetrigao MLA Sheikh Noorul Hassan, Khangabok MLA Okram Surjakumar, and Thoubal Deputy Commissioner Yumnam Robita, IAS.

During the visit, the Chief Minister met the bereaved family members and expressed his condolences over their loss. He assured them that the state government would stand by them during this difficult time and provide all possible assistance.

Khemchand also prayed for peace for the departed soul and strength for the grieving family as they cope with the loss.

Later, a one-minute silence was observed during a public meeting at Sangaiyumpham in memory of the deceased.

The Chief Minister reiterated that the state government remains committed to achieving lasting peace, genuine reconciliation and justice for all communities in Manipur.

Meanwhile, the Joint Action Committee (JAC) formed in connection with Rakesh Singh’s death expressed gratitude to the Chief Minister and the accompanying MLAs for visiting the bereaved family and sharing their grief.

The JAC acknowledged the visit as the family continues to mourn the loss of the youth.
